ns2:section.sectionText: ADV 150 and 281 are not being enforced as pre-requisites on this course. To register, students must have permission from their cooperating instructor. To receive permission and register for this course, you will need to complete an Independent Study Form found here: https://go.illinois.edu/IndependentStudy. Students must complete all sections of the form before it can be submitted for review by their participating instructor. Once the form has been reviewed and approved by the department, the student will receive further registration information via email from the College of Media Student Services Center.
